seo.title: Free solar simulator: production and savings | Soliance
seo.description: Estimate in 2 minutes the power, battery, self-sufficiency and savings of your roof in the 06, 83 and 13 departments. Refined by a precise study.

hero.title: Estimate the production and savings of your roof.

wizard.privacyHint: We save nothing during the simulation: your answers only reach us if you request the study. Address suggestions come from the French National Address Base (IGN).

fields.roofAreaHint: Free, unshaded area: up to {{panels}} panels of 500 W ({{kwc, number}} kWp, about 5 m² per kWp).
fields.monthlyBillHint: Average amount of your bills including tax, in euros per month.

addressSuggestions.label: Suggested addresses

errors.MONTHLY_BILL_INVALID: Enter an amount between €{{min}} and €{{max, number}} per month, for example €180.
errors.ANNUAL_CONSUMPTION_INVALID: Enter a consumption between 1,000 and 50,000 kWh per year.

result.lead: Here is the estimate of your installation with a battery. It will be refined during the precise study, based on your actual consumption, your household profile and the features of your house.
result.profileNotice: This estimate relies on a typical consumption profile, derived from your bill, your daytime presence and your equipment. It can be improved: with your actual Linky readings and a visit of your roof, the free study gives your exact figures.
result.surplus: Remaining surplus: ≈ {{kwh, number}} kWh per year, bought back at €{{tariff, number}}/kWh (≈ €{{value, number}}). It is not counted in the savings shown: we store it, we no longer sell it.
result.price: Price quoted after the study, fixed and detailed.
result.leadWithoutBattery: Here is the estimate of your solar installation, without a battery. It will be refined during the detailed study, from your real consumption, your household profile and the features of your home.
result.profileNoticeAnnual: This estimate relies on the yearly consumption you entered, spread according to your daytime presence and your equipment. With your real Linky readings and a visit of your roof, the free study gives your exact figures.
result.profileNoticeReference: This estimate relies on a reference household spending €180 a month on electricity, as no bill was entered. The free study uses your real consumption and a visit of your roof.
result.surplusWithoutBattery: Surplus: ≈ {{kwh, number}} kWh per year go to the grid, bought back at €{{tariff, number}}/kWh (≈ €{{value, number}}). A battery would let you use them in the evening.
result.targetOutOfReach: With your consumption profile, the simulation stays below {{target}}% of needs covered, even with the largest battery offered ({{battery, number}} kWh): your evening and winter needs exceed what it can store. Your adviser will look with you at how to go further.
result.targetOutOfReachChosenBattery: With the chosen battery, the installation stays below {{target}}% of needs covered. Go back to the advised battery to get closer.
result.beyondRoof_one: The advised installation takes more panels than your roof holds by its surface ({{count}} panel): the on-site study will check the layout.
result.beyondRoof_other: The advised installation takes more panels than your roof holds by its surface ({{count}} panels): the on-site study will check the layout.

capture.title: Get the free detailed study
capture.description: An advisor goes over these figures with your actual consumption, your household profile and the features of your house — the study we carry out for 100% of our installations — then sends you a fixed-price quote.
capture.consent: I agree to be contacted by Soliance by phone or email about my request.
capture.successDescription: Thank you! An advisor reviews your estimate and calls you back within 2 business days to prepare the precise study.
